description: Pittston, PA — Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s campaign today announced that he has earned the endorsement of the Pennsylvania Laborers’ District Council (LIUNA), which cited his steadfast support for fair labor standards, commitment to improving working conditions, and strong advocacy for economic development that creates good-paying jobs.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Pennsylvania Laborers’ District Council Endorses Rob Bresnahan for Congress - Rob for PA
